factor_equity.name: A2 Stock factor ranking + SMA(200) filter, ATR trailing stop (US large caps, IBKR)
factor_equity.thesis: Long-only tilt toward stocks that rank well on 12-1 month momentum, EBITDA/EV and quality (ROE, gross margin, low leverage). Expect heavy post-publication decay (McLean & Pontiff 2016).
factor_equity.note: Free data has no point-in-time fundamentals, so the backtest can only test the momentum leg, on point-in-time S&P 500 membership (no sector exclusion and no price floor in the backtest, because only today's sectors and adjusted prices are available). Delisted names are often missing from Yahoo, which biases the backtest upward; coverage is reported. The UCITS factor-ETF proxy (factor_ucits_proxy) is the honest check on what a multi-factor tilt earned.
